snippet.title: Deaths of Peck: Teaser Trailer | Steam | THE LINE
snippet.description:
🔥 WISHLIST NOW on Steam! https://store.steampowered.com/app/3174780/Deaths_Of_Peck/ 🔥

THE GOBLIN IS OUT OF THE BAG 🧨

Deaths of Peck is officially a GAME!!

Deaths of Peck started as a crazy idea from JuanPe Arroyo… So we built a Playtest to prove it works.. It does!  and now we need your help to turn it into a full game.

👉 Wishlist it on Steam to show YOUR support 👀
👉 Share it with your friends

💀 THE GAME:
A fast-paced 2D platformer where the only way to WIN… is to DIE.
Play as Peck, a tiny goblin cursed with immortality.
Orcs took your friends. No matter how many times you die trying to rescue them, you always bounce back stronger - in this charmingly gory, hand-drawn adventure.

🚨Wishlist and follow the game on Steam to find out when the PLAYTEST drops 🚨

Trailer Credits
Creator: JuanPe Arroyo
Music: Box of Toys Audio
EP: James Duveen
Development Production Coordinator: Tabitha Kearney

#DeathsOfPeck #WishlistNow #Steam #IndieGame
